requirements.title: The system MUST parse and validate typed durable wait receipts containing waiter item/generation, predecessor item/generation, canonical shared reservation tokens, and host authority; it MUST reject self-edges and any missing, stale, conflicting, non-overlapping, or unreadable authority. (covers AC-001, AC-002)

requirements.title: The pure detector MUST derive exactly reciprocal A-waits-B plus B-waits-A from the authoritative current receipt set independent of comment order, while one-way waits, cleared overlaps, durable dependencies, and unrelated rooms remain negative controls. (covers AC-001, AC-002)

requirements.title: A detected cycle MUST freeze shared-token edits and idempotently create or reuse exactly one ADR-0051 room with back-references on both participants. (covers AC-003)
requirements.text: A detected cycle MUST freeze shared-token edits and idempotently create or reuse exactly one ADR-0051 room with back-references on both participants. (covers AC-003)

requirements.title: Arbitration MUST require one current host-authored precedence receipt naming distinct winner and loser, and MUST bind that host to both the live board-orchestrator lease and the current minted caller rather than a supplied string; same-revision conflicts fail closed, and revision N+1 MUST reference revision N's digest and state a measured reversal reason. (covers AC-004)

(covers AC-004)

requirements.title: Applying precedence MUST narrow the loser's shared reservations without releasing its claim, retain the winner's claim and reservations, and expose an observed post-state rather than treating write completion as authority. (covers AC-005)
requirements.text: Applying precedence MUST narrow the loser's shared reservations without releasing its claim, retain the winner's claim and reservations, and expose an observed post-state rather than treating write completion as authority. (covers AC-005)

requirements.title: Resuming the loser MUST require observed winner landing, fetch/rebase onto the current base, a fresh overlap result, explicit re-widen, and any exact-head review required by the changed tree. (covers AC-006)
requirements.text: Resuming the loser MUST require observed winner landing, fetch/rebase onto the current base, a fresh overlap result, explicit re-widen, and any exact-head review required by the changed tree. (covers AC-006)

requirements.title: The production writer MUST recover from ambiguous transport failure at every mutation boundary by re-reading live state and MUST make retries idempotent without duplicate rooms, back-references, precedence receipts, or path mutations. (covers AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, AC-006, AC-007)

requirements.title: Pure and compiled production-route tests MUST reproduce the `.github#2772`/`.github#2797` cycle, assert one room/current precedence, preserve the narrowed losing claim, cover winner-land/loser-resume, inject every writer boundary, and record observed-red inversions for every detector/arbitration predicate. (covers AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, AC-006, AC-007, AC-008)

(covers AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, AC-006, AC-007, AC-008)

requirements.title: Policy documentation MUST put automatic detection/arbitration before manual negotiation and state that occurrences fold onto `.github#2801` unless a separate root cause is adjudicated. (covers AC-003, AC-008)
requirements.text: Policy documentation MUST put automatic detection/arbitration before manual negotiation and state that occurrences fold onto `.github#2801` unless a separate root cause is adjudicated. (covers AC-003, AC-008)

requirements.title: A complete authoritative lease census MUST route every external Coordination need to the sole live board-orchestrator generation, bind request repository/holder identity to the request ref and current minted caller, persist the blocking request idempotently against that generation, refuse a competing lane, and make the current orchestrator project the highest external block to board Severity Critical before ordinary board work. (covers AC-009, AC-010)

requirements.title: Only authoritative lease absence/expiry MAY enable takeover; takeover MUST use the next immutable generation and a lowest-comment-id CAS, while stale requests, conflicting/live duplicate generations, unreadable state, and losing contenders fail closed without deleting the winner. (covers AC-011, AC-012, AC-013)

decisions.title: Use additive, versioned records and discriminated unions in `Client.fs/.fsi`; keep I/O in `Writes.fs/.fsi` and pure validation/detection independent of comment order.
decisions.decision: Use additive, versioned records and discriminated unions in `Client.fs/.fsi`; keep I/O in `Writes.fs/.fsi` and pure validation/detection independent of comment order.

decisions.title: The room idempotency key is the digest of the canonical participant claim generations plus canonical shared tokens. A retry first searches complete live room/back-reference state; unreadable or conflicting matches fail closed.
decisions.decision: The room idempotency key is the digest of the canonical participant claim generations plus canonical shared tokens. A retry first searches complete live room/back-reference state; unreadable or conflicting matches fail closed.

decisions.title: A precedence receipt is revisioned and digest-linked. Revision 1 has no prior digest; later revisions must name the exact prior digest and measured reversal reason. Apply/resume outcomes carry observed claim/path/head facts and requested next effects.
decisions.decision: A precedence receipt is revisioned and digest-linked. Revision 1 has no prior digest; later revisions must name the exact prior digest and measured reversal reason. Apply/resume outcomes carry observed claim/path/head facts and requested next effects.

decisions.title: Narrowing the loser is a claim-preserving path replacement. Resumption is a separate guarded transition authorized only after observed winner landing, updated base/head, clean overlap, explicit re-widen, and required review evidence.
decisions.decision: Narrowing the loser is a claim-preserving path replacement. Resumption is a separate guarded transition authorized only after observed winner landing, updated base/head, clean overlap, explicit re-widen, and required review evidence.

decisions.title: A complete lease/request census is the sole board-orchestrator authority. External requests are idempotent and bound to its live generation; stale generation races refuse. Same-generation contenders use GitHub comment order and losers delete only their own marker.
decisions.decision: A complete lease/request census is the sole board-orchestrator authority. External requests are idempotent and bound to its live generation; stale generation races refuse. Same-generation contenders use GitHub comment order and losers delete only their own marker.
